name: mangsang
description: The coherence manager for every artifact in a project — plan, code, tests. Stores relations between anchors (a document section, a function, a test), each signed by whoever judged it — a person, a delegation citing the person's recorded words, or the agent itself with its reason — fingerprints them, and says which relation went stale when one end changed. Machines keep it because the next agent has no memory and nobody can read everything.
